rooms.data-display: Read-only presentation of data and metrics: table, badge, stat-card, progress-metric, simple-bar-chart, activity-list, status-list
rooms.form-controls: Interactive input components and form wiring: button, input, textarea, password-input, message composer, dropdown menu, and react-hook-form form primitives
rooms.layout-surfaces: Structural containers and iconography primitives that other components compose on top of: card, icon
rooms.other: none of the above / cannot tell
rooms.overlays-feedback: Transient and layered UI: dialogs/modals, toast notifications (toast, toaster, use-toast hook), and skeleton loading placeholders
rooms.styling-utils: Cross-cutting styling helpers and public surface: cn class-merge helper (utils.ts) and the index.ts barrel re-exporting all components
rooms.uploads: File attachment upload UI with per-file status state machine (idle/uploading/uploaded/failed) and progress: attachment-upload-card
